snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Mecha Sonic Moveset mod trailer [Outdated]
snippet.description:
This video is outdated, V2 has been released, here is the trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=idUqeZ9jgBk

A moveset for Mecha Sonic inspired by his appearance in Super Mario Bros Z made by Sintomatikoa and me.

Download link of the moveset: https://gamebanana.com/mods/495584

Mods in this trailer:
Mecha Sonic (skin + voice only): https://gamebanana.com/mods/395401
Shadow: https://gamebanana.com/mods/425829
Axem Rangers: https://gamebanana.com/mods/479641
Vanishing Island stage: https://gamebanana.com/mods/438308
DBZ sounds for meteor moves: https://gamebanana.com/sounds/57702

SMBZ scenes are from Mark Haynes, the saga creator.

Musics used in the saga scenes and in this trailer:
Fierce Battle (Metal Slug 5/Episode 7 fight): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udc701ZyM3o
Doomsday zone remix (Sonic 3/Episode 6 fight): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FnqRbHJ-So8
